title: CLI: kallax db:backup / db:restore
description: SQLite backup API (VACUUM INTO) + restore 校验 (schema_version match + integrity_check)。用户可导 .kallax/backups/*.db, 支持跨机迁移。
acceptance: db:backup 生成合法 SQLite 文件, PRAGMA integrity_check 通过
db:restore 校验 schema_version, 拒绝低版本
端到端 backup → restore → SELECT count(*) 一致
